label: US Kids Golf – Texas state championships
hint: US Kids Golf state-level events held in Texas only (e.g. Texas State Championship, Texas Spring/Fall State Invitational). Follow links to the list or search of state events to find the Texas ones; ignore other states.

label: US Kids Golf – regional championships
hint: US Kids Golf regional championships held in Texas or a neighboring state (Oklahoma, Louisiana, Arkansas, New Mexico). Put the city and state in the city field (e.g. 'Horseshoe Bay, TX'). Follow links to the list of regional events; ignore regionals in other states.

label: US Kids Golf – World Championships
hint: The upcoming US Kids Golf World Championship events (e.g. the World Championship and Teen World Championship, usually at Pinehurst, NC). Put city and state in the city field. Follow links to the current year's World Championship pages.

label: AJGA – tournaments in Texas
hint: AJGA tournaments held in Texas only (any Texas city). Skip tournaments in other states. Use the tournament's own page link as the url when the schedule shows one.

label: TGA / Legends Junior Tour
hint: Junior events run by the Texas Golf Association: the Legends Junior Tour (LJT) schedule and TGA junior championships (e.g. Texas Junior Amateur, junior invitationals). Skip adult and senior events. Follow links to the Legends Junior Tour or junior schedule page.
